summary:
Plan for size-check (analysis-tools r50-r52, `tools size`) is in plan.md.
The scenarios are red because `a Python project in git`, the tracks, untracked and prints steps are undefined, and `tools` has no `size` subcommand (rc 2).
The change: a size subcommand with --limit (default 300) in scripts/tools plus its contract line; a new scripts/tools_size.py; a new analysis_tools_size_steps.py, imported by test_analysis_tools.py.
D1: create CLAUDE.md with the module map and the 300 limit. The work-item settles this.
D2: size skips probed(), so a project with no Python file prints nothing and exits 0 (r50/r51).
D3: outside git, size refuses (r49). D4: a non-integer --limit exits 2.
D5: paths come from git NUL-separated, avoiding the whitespace split in check --base.
The agent prompts are edited to run `tools size --limit <CLAUDE.md limit>`. tools_env.py is dropped from the file set.
No existing test breaks.
Open cases: a deleted tracked file, --limit 0 or negative, and the four files over 300 in this repo today.
